name: Mercure Kuala Lumpur Glenmarie
short_description: A 219-room Mercure hotel with 10 executive suites in the Utropolis Glenmarie development, Shah Alam, roughly 40 minutes from KLIA.
ai_summary: Mercure Kuala Lumpur Glenmarie is a 219-room hotel plus 10 executive suites set within the Utropolis Glenmarie development in Shah Alam, part of the greater Kuala Lumpur metro area. The property leans into an academic-inspired design that mimics a college library with book-themed decor, alongside a rooftop-accessible pool, Warna All Day Dining restaurant, and six meeting rooms. Guests consistently praise comfortable beds, well-tuned air conditioning, and a varied breakfast buffet, while a subset of reviews describe standard rooms as small, in-room equipment as minimal, and the location as somewhat removed from the main KL/Petaling Jaya scene. Subang Airport is about 18 minutes away and KLIA around 40 minutes, making the hotel more suited to guests with business in the Shah Alam/Glenmarie corridor than to sightseeing-focused stays.

faqs.question: How far is Mercure Kuala Lumpur Glenmarie from the airport?
faqs.answer: Subang Airport is about 13 km away, roughly an 18-minute drive, while Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA) is around a 40-minute drive. The hotel sits within the Utropolis Glenmarie development in Shah Alam, so it suits guests with business in the Glenmarie/Shah Alam corridor more than travelers prioritizing a short airport transfer.

faqs.question: What is distinctive about Mercure Kuala Lumpur Glenmarie's design?
faqs.answer: The hotel uses an academic-inspired design that cleverly mimics a college library, with book-themed decor and riddle-carved columns throughout public spaces. Combined with a rooftop-accessible pool and Warna All Day Dining restaurant, it gives the property a distinct identity compared to a typical business-focused Mercure hotel in the Klang Valley.
